name: St. Louis
local_rules: St. Louis Parking Violations Bureau (PVB) handles all parking citation appeals. Late fees double after 30 days and balloon to $80 after 45 days — timely submission is critical. SLU (Saint Louis University) tickets issued on Laclede Avenue may be private university citations rather than city-issued; verify issuer before processing.

confirmation_note: St. Louis Parking Violations Bureau (PVB) handles all parking citation appeals. You have 30 days from issuance to submit your appeal. Late fees double after 30 days and balloon to $80 after 45 days — timely submission is critical. Note that SLU (Saint Louis University) tickets issued on Laclede Avenue may be private university citations rather than city-issued; verify the issuer before processing.
